Problem: Manual tracking of Instagram account growth and engagement lacks real-time insights and scalability across multiple accounts
Solution: A real-time analytics system that automates data collection, computes engagement metrics, and provides dashboard-based insights with comparison and alerting capabilities
Architecture: Hybrid data collection system using unofficial APIs with proxy rotation and scraping fallback
Data is processed and stored for time-series analytics
Results are visualized through a web dashboard
Core Features: Likes and comments per post monitoring
Performance: Stable operation using proxy rotation and fallback mechanisms
Challenges: Maintaining reliable data collection with API limitations
Handling rate limits and access restrictions
Ensuring data consistency across multiple accounts
Managing proxy rotation and fallback logic
Outcome: Demonstrates the ability to design and build real-time analytics platforms with automated data pipelines and intelligent monitoring features
